an8.13:1.1: Aṭṭhahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgato rañño bhaddo assājāniyo rājāraho hoti rājabhoggo, rañño aṅgan tveva saṃkhaṃ gacchati.
an8.13:1.3: Idha bhikkhave rañño bhaddo assājāniyo ubhato sujāto hoti
an8.13:1.5: yassaṃ disāyaṃ aññe pi bhaddā assājāniyā jāyanti, tassaṃ disāyaṃ jāto hoti;
an8.13:1.6: yaṃ kho pan' assa bhojanaṃ denti
an8.13:1.9: jegucchī hoti uccāraṃ vā passāvaṃ vā abhinisīdituṃ vā abhinipajjituṃ vā;
an8.13:1.10: so rato hoti sukhasaṃvāso na aññe asse ubbejetā;
an8.13:1.11: yāni kho pan' assa honti sāṭheyyāni kūṭeyyāni jimheyyāni vaṅkeyyāni, tāni yathābhūtaṃ sārathissa āvikattā hoti,
an8.13:1.14: ‘kāmaṃ maññe assā vahantu vā mā vā, aham ettha vahissāmī' ti cittaṃ uppādeti;
an8.13:1.15: gacchanto kho pana ujumaggen' eva gacchati;
an8.13:1.16: thāmavā hoti yāva jīvitamaraṇapariyādānā thāmaṃ upadaṃsetā.
an8.13:1.17: Imehi kho bhikkhave aṭṭhah' aṅgehi samannāgato rañño bhaddo assājāniyo rājāraho hoti rājabhoggo, rañño aṅgan tveva saṃkhaṃ gacchati. 3.
an8.13:2.1: Evam eva kho bhikkhave aṭṭhahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti . . . pe . . . anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa.
an8.13:2.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlavā hoti pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati ācāragocarasampanno, anumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu;
an8.13:2.4: yaṃ kho pan' assa bhojanaṃ denti
an8.13:2.7: jegucchī hoti, jigucchati kāyaduccaritena vacīduccaritena manoduccaritena,
an8.13:2.9: so rato hoti sukhasaṃvāso na aññe bhikkhū ubbejetā;
an8.13:2.10: yāni kho pan' assa honti sāṭheyyāni kūṭeyyāni jimheyyāni vaṅkeyyāni, tāni yathābhūtaṃ āvikattā hoti Satthari vā viññūsu vā sabrahmacārīsu,
an8.13:2.11: tesam assa Satthā vā viññū vā sabrahmacārī abhinimmadanāya vāyamati;
an8.13:2.13: ‘kāmaṃ maññe bhikkhū sikkhantu vā mā vā, aham ettha sikkhissāmī' ti cittaṃ uppādeti;
an8.13:2.14: gacchanto kho pana ujumaggen' eva gacchati,
an8.13:2.18: ‘kāmaṃ taco ca nahāru ca aṭṭhi ca avasissatu, sarīre upasussatu maṃsalohitaṃ, yan taṃ purisathāmena purisaviriyena purisaparakkamena pattabbaṃ, na taṃ apāpuṇitvā viriyassa saṇṭhānaṃ bhavissatī' ti.
an8.13:2.19: Imehi kho bhikkhave aṭṭhahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti . . . pe . . . anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassā
